title: BINI members fangirl over BTS at Taiwan concert

blocks.text: Days after wrapping up their “Signals” world tour, BINI members Aiah, Colet, Stacey, Mikha and Sheena took time off to attend the “Arirang” concert of K-pop supergroup BTS in Kaohsiung, Taiwan. The P-pop artists were all smiles as they posed for a photo inside the Kaohsiung National Stadium on Thursday, Nov. 19. Snaps of them at the event were shared on the girl group’s official Facebook page. The BINI members opted for mostly dark-colored outfits, with Sheena wearing an ensemble seemingly inspired by BTS member Suga. “Fangirl mode: ACTIVATED,” the caption read.
